items.title: User Tracking Web Portal
items.description: A web application for tracking user activities (location point), having real-time updates and interactive maps. Portal contains reporting features, with personalized dashboards and analytics. Users can perform some actions related to uploading and managing its data.

items.title: User Tracking Mobile Application

items.title: Primesys User Backend System

items.title: OPD ERP — Clinic Management System
items.description: Doctor ERP is a full-stack clinic and hospital management system that digitizes the complete patient journey — from walk-in registration and appointment booking to live token queues, doctor consultation, smart prescriptions, POS billing, and pharmacy dispensing — in a single unified application. Built with NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma on the backend and React 19, TanStack Router, and Tailwind on the frontend, it features role-native interfaces for admin, doctor, receptionist, pharmacist, and nurse users, backed by a granular role-based access control system with JWT refresh-token rotation.

details.tagline: Full-stack clinic & hospital management system covering registration → appointments → queue → consultation → prescriptions → billing/POS → pharmacy dispensing, built for admin, doctor, receptionist, pharmacist & nurse roles.

roles.name: Admin
roles.blurb: Platform control — users, roles & permissions, master data and audit logs.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.blurb: Consult workflow — vitals, diagnosis, smart prescriptions and order generation.

roles.name: Receptionist
roles.blurb: Front desk — registration, appointments and the live waiting-room token board.

roles.name: Pharmacist
roles.blurb: Full-width POS terminal for dispensing, billing and receipts.

roles.name: Nurse
roles.blurb: Token flow and vitals capture between consultation and pharmacy.

highlights.title: End-to-end coverage
highlights.description: One system from registration to pharmacy checkout — no context-switching between apps.

highlights.title: Role-native interfaces
highlights.description: A POS cashier gets a full-width terminal, doctors get a consult workflow, reception sees the waiting room.

highlights.title: Smart prescriptions
highlights.description: Typeahead drug search, auto-generated lab/radiology/procedure orders, substitution & allergy tracking.

highlights.title: RBAC security
highlights.description: Granular resource:action permissions on every endpoint, with refresh-token rotation and theft detection.

highlights.title: Real-time queues
highlights.description: Live token board auto-refreshing so reception, nurses and doctors always share the same state.

modules.name: Queue Management
modules.description: Real-time token queue per doctor with status transitions — WAITING → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED / SKIPPED / NO_SHOW.

modules.name: Appointments
modules.description: Walk-in, scheduled & follow-up appointments; slots auto-generated from recurring doctor schedules.

modules.name: Consultation
modules.description: Vitals (BP, pulse, SpO₂, temp, weight, height), diagnosis and clinical notes.

modules.name: Prescriptions
modules.description: Drug catalog search with substitution tracking & allergy warnings; auto-generates lab/radiology/procedure orders.

modules.name: Billing / POS
modules.description: Discount engine (% or flat), CASH/CARD/UPI modes, receipts and a refund audit trail.

modules.name: Pharmacy
modules.description: Partial or full dispensing with substitution tracking linked to the original prescription.

modules.name: RBAC
modules.description: Granular resource:action permissions with an ADMIN wildcard and refresh-token rotation with theft detection.

modules.name: Doctor Schedules
modules.description: Weekly recurring schedules that auto-generate bookable slots.

items.title: CodyERP — Restaurant Management System
items.description: An all-in-one restaurant management platform in active development — POS billing, inventory tracking, staff management, and financial reporting in one place. Ships with developer/demo credentials for quickly inspecting the underlying data while building out new modules.

items.title: OPD ERP
items.description: The accounting and finance module of the OPD ERP suite — ledgers, invoicing, and expense tracking that plug into the same clinic management system. In active development.
